scripts.dev: concurrently -n FRONTEND,BACKEND -c blue,green "npm run backend" "npm run frontend"
scripts.build: (python3 -m venv venv && ./venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt || pip3 install -r requirements.txt || pip install -r requirements.txt || echo 'pip install skipped') && npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix backend
